newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - May 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - May 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE Minister of Finance Sheikh Hamdan bin Rashid al- Maktoum praised Arab states who had made great strides towards adopting free market economic policies.
- U.S warns Iran of action if it closes Strait of Hormuz.
- UAE President Sheikh Zaid calls for Arab unity.
- Arab finance ministers say Arab economies improving amid better investment climate.
- UAE finance minister says UAE has granted 90 billion dirhams to development projects in the Arab world.
